朝鮮總督府統計年報 1913

Chōsen Sōtokufu tōkei nenpō (Statistical Annual of the Government-General of Korea), 大正二年 (Taishō 2), published 1915
朝鮮總督府, 京城, 1915 (大正四年)

All 580 numbered tables and a few unnumbered sub-tables are transcribed (589 tables, about 162,000 figure cells), with the contents; the 凡例, the contents pages and the colophon are not. Tables printed across both pages of a spread are joined into one; very long tables were read in sections by different readers and joined. Each spread was read once by a Claude Sonnet agent from tight crops, with no second reading. 652 cells could not be read and are marked [?] (many are last digits cut off at a column rule or the gutter); 4 that a printed total fixes exactly are filled in and shown with a blue background (inferred). Printed totals were re-added; many that do not add up (often by a round 10, 100 or 1,000, which points to misprints in the original) are kept as printed and noted, and where a digit was ambiguous only between 3 and 8 and exactly one reading made a printed total reconcile, that reading is used and noted. The book's printed errata slip (正誤表, 160 corrections) is given as a note on each table it corrects; the figures themselves are kept as printed. Two frames of the scan repeat the page before and were skipped. Where the original prints a question mark (some 明治四十四年 cells of the tax tables) it is kept as ?.
